title: Dev Log - 1st look at the newly designed boss VORRHKKA, THE HUNDRED-EYED
author: dank_summers
selftext:
This is for my upcoming movement based Action RPG: Cave Drop



The queen at the bottom of the cave has been completely rebuilt. She's now Vorrhkka, the Hundred-Eyed: a giant golden centipede covered in glowing eyes, with great pincers that snap at you if you stand in front of her. Her lair is now the Hall of Gold.

\- At half health she goes into her golden haze. She dives into the ground and tunnels after you, the ground under your feet gets marked, and then she bursts out, throws you aside and rears up almost straight out of the hole while gold fills the whole hall

\- When she topples, the crash hits hard right under her and sends a wider shock wave out after it

\- Use your grapple to try and fling onto her back and target her vulnerable glowing crystals

\- Stay on her back too long and she'll crack her tail up her body and fling you off

\- Get on top of her head and Press Q to mount letting you control the queen for a brief moment, try to crash her into the pillar to stun her

\- Beat her and she drops the Heart of Vorrhkka

  
Rest of Dev log can be read here - [https://wilsonb9000.itch.io/cave-drop/devlog/1729831/ride-the-mini-bosses-face-the-hundred-eyed-queen-a-village-thats-alive](https://wilsonb9000.itch.io/cave-drop/devlog/1729831/ride-the-mini-bosses-face-the-hundred-eyed-queen-a-village-thats-alive)

The demo is free to try on Itch as well - [https://wilsonb9000.itch.io/cave-drop](https://wilsonb9000.itch.io/cave-drop) 

If you like movement games or unique rpgs id love to hear if you can beat the boss as of now no one has done it to my knowledge.

comments.author: KimAndersenCock
comments.body: How tf did you make this? Claude? I am trying something similar in terms of 2.5D Hollow Knight-like graphics, but I am using GPT Astra 6 and it looks so much wrose. My game is fully 2D and the background i sjust a lousy picture generated by the AI Dx

replies.author: dank_summers
replies.body: Yeah Claude and blender. Reference images help a ton, and then a bunch of small iterations on the tiny details until it feels just right

comments.author: ChirpXel
comments.body: Not bad. But you need to do some adjustments so the boss stands out more from the environment. Right now with your current lighting and shading he blends with the environment too much and is hard to visually see

replies.author: dank_summers
replies.body:
Yeah I see what your talking about.

I will say, when you're actually fighting it, it is fking huge and easy to see , although there is a low visibility phase where she fills the arena with a haze
